pr_body:
Fixes: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/105025

So far, the legacy `PROJECT` command was tolerated by the parser, that just returned a warning and treated it as a `KEEP`.
This PR removes `PROJECT` keyword from the grammar, so it won't be allowed in queries anymore.
pr_title: ES|QL: remove PROJECT keyword from the grammar
pr_comment: Hi @luigidellaquila, I've created a changelog YAML for you. *Note* that since this PR is labelled `>breaking`, you need to update the changelog YAML to fill out the extended information sections.

review_comment: We need to see if there are any blockers on removing this section, in the context of BWC. This being a warning (vs. error) tells me we need to check the aspect of bwc.

This was checked in Kibana, but the team is already aware of this change.
Apart from that, we should not have other dependencies.
About strict BWC in terms of inter-node communication, we are safe since this change only touches the grammar; the plan and the serialized data structures do not require any chanages.
